Institute
PK id
UK code; name

User
PK id; FK instituteId
email; role; isActive

Course
PK id; FK instituteId
FK instructorId (nullable)
title; section; isArchived

Session
PK id; FK userId
UK tokenHash; expiresAt

Enrollment
PK id; FK courseId, studentId
UK courseId + studentId
status

SyllabusItem
PK id; FK courseId
type; dueDate; maxPoints

CategoryWeight
PK id; FK gradingPolicyId
category; weightPercentage
UK gradingPolicyId + category

StudentSubmission
PK id; FK syllabusItemId, studentId
grade; status; submittedAt
UK syllabusItemId + studentId

Note
PK id; FK creatorId, instituteId
title; content; archived

FlashcardDeck
PK id; FK creatorId
title; optional courseId

CalendarEvent
PK id; FK creatorId, instituteId
eventDate; optional courseId

ActivityTemplate
PK id; FK createdBy, courseId
activityType

Selected ownership relationships. Additional card, task, study-session and progression
records remain in the release schema. Nullable course links do not imply enrollment.

ActivitySubmission
PK id; FK templateId, studentId
score; maxScore; passed

GithubSubmission
PK id; FK repoLinkId, userId
FK syllabusItemId; commitSha

KxPost
PK id; FK authorId, instituteId

KxAnswer
PK id; FK postId, authorId
optional FK verifiedById

FK fields also reference the corresponding User or SyllabusItem.
CodeLab execution, Git coursework and Knowledge Exchange retain separate records.

User extended
PK id; facultyPrograms[]
nullable headProgram

Course extended
PK id; academicProgram
scheduleRevision

Note extended
PK id; FK creatorId
nullable sourceEventId
UK creatorId + sourceEventId

CourseSchedule new
PK id; FK courseId, instructorId
weekdays; time; date bounds
room; timezone; revision

CalendarEvent extended
PK id; FK creatorId
audience; time kind; start/end
nullable UK sourceNoteId; version

CourseScheduleException new
PK id; FK scheduleId
originalDate; kind; replacement
UK scheduleId + originalDate

Dashed entities show the agreed target, not completed migrations.
Event-to-note snapshots allow one owned note per creator and source event.
Institute.deanId, audience rules and other FK links are described in the text.
